logicalIssueProposals.title: Migrate expanded bilingual manufacturing knowledge library and corrected technical/SEO content
logicalIssueProposals.body:
## Outcome
Migrate the final researched content across the nineteen Knowledge Center pages, including twelve new guides (five CNC, three materials, two finishing, one inspection and one process-selection guide). Keep the seven existing e1edc6de routes updated rather than duplicated.

## Immutable source scope
Content/SEO contributors: 73357e3fff70a4b6131d1a12413e9f680aec319b, 51158c450e713863fe46a82d6b150b3493ad65d6, 94eaf9bb0571594114b8aaab6335cb446ea9ed2e, 995ab350353fa81cbcfdba8f9b4148e02493588a, f69f8aa2682cdfd2bb57beb7f3dcbfc548157fff and f96a6cbe23407ac25af3ebc4bc669296a09ac164. Exact parents/all path histories belong to the intake JSON; these commits also contain separately owned visuals/navigation.

## Contracts and acceptance
- Preserve final EN/TH article text, titles/descriptions, headings, anchors, worked examples, units/tables, technical qualifications, internal service links and external research references. Examples are explanatory, not machine settings, held-stock statements or certified drawings.
- Preserve factual corrections: manufacturing technology terminology; metrology and reverse-engineering qualifications; printable orientation guidance; diametral c=D−d versus concentric radial c/2; revision review/approval loop. Port final corrected text/resources, not intermediate earlier blobs.
- Extend the existing public search route catalog and source/SEO verification route inventories for all twelve additions; check canonical, EN/TH/x-default links, crawlability and one-H1 behavior under both supported renderers. Retain all source test obligations: ApplicationPageMigrationSourceTests, KnowledgePageMigrationSourceTests, SeoBusinessContractTests, TechnicalSeoTests and both ProductionSeoVerifier paths.
- Coordinate grouped contents/current-page behavior with K3 and visual references with K2. Asset references must not activate before custody and actual package/HTTP delivery are verified.

## Dependencies and duplicate check
#596 explicitly tracks preceding e1edc6de1537712f52c016318e311c8dd3819e5c, not these ten descendants. Existing per-route issues are related architecture obligations, not duplicates or proof of new-source acceptance. Coordinate on the accepted target revision and preserve unrelated ongoing work.

This is source intake, not implementation or migration acceptance. Original committed objects remain read-only. Preserve every full source SHA/parent/path/blob occurrence in the intake manifest; do not close a whole commit merely because one logical bundle is implemented. Port into the existing Legacy Blazor static-SSR producer and retained Razor renderer where supported; preserve current themes/fonts, consent and downstream boundaries. Hosted exact-head Release zero warnings/errors, focused and affected/full suites, relevant browser/asset/SEO/format/static/security/package checks and unchanged raw coverage remain mandatory, followed by protected-main verification. No deployment, database/API/auth/provider/pricing/SDK role changes. CNC educational content is not CNC quotation/analyzer expansion.

logicalIssueProposals.title: Migrate exact Knowledge Center photo/diagram custody and final responsive educational imagery
logicalIssueProposals.body:
## Outcome
Preserve all final committed image assets and their complete provenance/correction history from source e1edc6de1537712f52c016318e311c8dd3819e5c..770cb58032969ae4a0fe169686b53ab61a44fff8: forty-two WebP files (twenty-one full/small pairs) and seventeen changed SVGs. Fifty-eight asset paths are new; anodize-dimensional-growth.svg is an existing asset revised in this range. Two additional prior diagrams remain inherited dependencies and must not be deleted merely because they are outside this delta.

## Immutable source scope
Principal custody/correction commits: c3f53426bfa3843441015a69a6624706f4b0bb98, cdb7e480238424f208a36f54dd1e9770db5a9506, 995ab350353fa81cbcfdba8f9b4148e02493588a, f69f8aa2682cdfd2bb57beb7f3dcbfc548157fff and f96a6cbe23407ac25af3ebc4bc669296a09ac164. Consumer insertion is in 94eaf9bb0571594114b8aaab6335cb446ea9ed2e and later corrections. Full path/pre/post blob histories are in intake; final blobs at770cb580 are authoritative for import, intermediate blobs remain disposition/provenance records.

## Acceptance
- Acquire only exact committed blobs in a separately authorized custody implementation. Verify raw Git SHA1, measured byte length and SHA256; no regenerated photographs, redrawn substitute diagrams, third-party downloads or inferred licensing/disclosure clearance. This intake reads metadata/text only and has not downloaded binary images or measured their SHA256.
- Retain eleven source verification/provenance documents, including photo prompts, diagram captions, fact audit, visual corrections, reading-image prompts/layout, formatting investigation and production-release note. Their historical validation/release claims do not qualify Legacy target runtime or authorize Legacy deployment.
- Safely parse SVGs; reject scripts, external references/entities, unsafe XML/namespace content; preserve exact approved bytes. Inspect final SVG dimensions/markers, complete dimension endpoint arrows, hole/thread/counterbore meaning, and correction-specific geometry. No certified standard/measurement claim.
- Verify source full/small sizes (source-declared1536x1024/768x512) by decoding files, not HTMLImageElement.naturalWidth equality. Browser acceptance checks decode success, intended currentSrc, 3:2 aspect ratio and responsive selection. Preserve eager/high-priority hero versus lazy issue/diagram delivery, source alt text, captions, scrollable labelled diagram viewports and full-size links.
- Retain corrected CNC preparation/inspection imagery and the new exaggerated warpage/chatter examples with their explicit illustrative/no-diagnostic-limit qualifications.
- Integrate deterministic asset packaging and verify actual image/SVG HTTP delivery, MIME/decoding and generated inventory. Custody alone is not visual/semantic/delivery acceptance.

logicalIssueProposals.body:
## Outcome
Migrate the final grouped library/sidebar, lazy local section search and linear reading orientation without duplicating the existing shell/router.

## Immutable source scope

The actual .Value template fix is ALREADY in adbed46b;770cb580 is not a second production fix. Use final source blobs, with all earlier parent/path mappings retained.

## Behavioral contracts
- Five native topic groups, nineteen library links, correct current-page/open-group state and generated current-article section links. Preserve no-JS browsing and the source mobile breakpoint/modal drawer behavior: inert restoration, Escape/backdrop/close, keyboard focus loop, focus restoration and same-page search-anchor focus.
- Local EN/TH search starts only after input; NFKC/case/whitespace normalization and all-term matching span heading/article title/English aliases/body, including numeric text3819.7. Preserve ranking150/80/40/1, default8 visible results with total count,160ms debounce, minimum2 normalized characters, three concurrent same-origin article loads,30-second abort, partial-index retry, clear/Enter behavior and pagehide cancellation.
- Use inert template parsing so indexing does not execute fetched scripts or eagerly load article photography; render results through textContent. Preserve culture query and section fragment in destinations, localized loading/empty/error/count/limited states and polite announcements.
- Render the client templates literally in EN/TH: Matches: {0} and Showing {0} of {1} matches. Narrow your search to see more. In MVC IHtmlLocalizer use .Value before Razor attribute rendering; in Blazor use the equivalent plain-string resource boundary. GET /knowledges/specifications must return200 in each culture and expose exact placeholders before JS substitution.
- Linear one-column in-article contents at desktop/mobile, visible heading, natural DOM/tab order, full-width44px targets, focus/hover feedback, unchanged anchor IDs. Preserve illustrative-photo additions with K2, without changing established fonts/container widths or adding sticky overlays.

Explicitly enroll Node tests in the existing hosted command; new files are not assumed auto-discovered. Exercise no eager fetch/photo loading, body-only numeric search, Thai/alias results, bounded results, retry recovery, drawer keyboard/inert behavior, literal-format regression, source anchors and narrow-screen overflow. Add lifecycle regressions for stale async completions/abort/BFCache as required by the actual target integration, without claiming original tests already cover them.
